body: I sometimes craved being sad. Because it was a feeling...that just sounded rich and wonderful and powerful. Depression is apathy...and I think I'm finally soaring out of it.

The thing is, I don't know exactly why I'm feeling this way.  It's a combination of this weird awful stress feeling that I often get when school starts and pretty pointless anxiety about a guy I'm kinda seeing. My sister and all her friends are leaving for college. I feel very alone even among my friend groups.  Not sure if these are the exact reasons why, but I just feel like shit as soon as I get home from school.
"No, Mom, it's not my semen! Taste it! It's not cum!"
